method: axis_instrument_forensics.py re-run at HEAD against the frames in docs/roadmap/palt_m6/texture_axes (output committed as axis_instrument_forensics_at_head.json — numbers reproduce the 67151ef record exactly, frames unchanged since), plus direct reading of the instrument code at HEAD.

F1_FRAME_PROVENANCE_16BIT_IS_8BIT.amendment: PNG IHDR headers prove every _16bit.png on disk is a GENUINE 16-bit RGBA file (bit_depth=16, colour_type=6, all 62 files). The writer was never broken. The defect sits in the READER: PIL silently downconverts 16-bit RGBA to uint8 on load, so the instrument measured 8-bit data from 16-bit files — and the forensic provenance block itself used PIL and therefore mischaracterized the file as 8-bit-on-disk. A finding about the finding, recorded rather than smoothed over.
F1_FRAME_PROVENANCE_16BIT_IS_8BIT.unchanged: every measured consequence stands — the reader-sensitivity numbers were measured through the actual (PIL) reading path; and R1 is the correct repair regardless, because a 16-bit PNG is still display-encoded and the scene-linear EXR is the only honest measurement frame.
F1_FRAME_PROVENANCE_16BIT_IS_8BIT.evidence: PNG IHDR bytes read directly; cv2 confirms uint16 on load.

F2_ALPHA_CHANNEL_CONTAMINATES_LUMINANCE.evidence: palette_powder_texture_axes._region_image at HEAD still does raw.astype(float).mean(axis=2) on 4-channel frames; reader-sensitivity at HEAD still flips GRAZING_BAND_CONTRAST (0.2683 contaminated / 0.1078 RGB / 0.1252 EXR).
F2_ALPHA_CHANNEL_CONTAMINATES_LUMINANCE.mitigating_note: the contaminated 0.2683 was NOT banked at HEAD — GRAZING_BAND_CONTRAST was REJECTED by its own admission gate at c375264 and counts toward nothing. The defect in the reader remains.

F3_SURFACE_AUTOCORRELATION_MM_IS_DEAD_BY.evidence: the axis failed its own positive fixture and is in rejected_axes in texture_axes_validation.json; diffuse_pair_rulings admitted_texture_axes = ['GRANULARITY_INDEX'] only, so it can reach no pair.
F3_SURFACE_AUTOCORRELATION_MM_IS_DEAD_BY.residual: R3's formal withdrawal (removal from the registry) and the SYNTHETIC_FIELD_CONTROL that turns the withdrawal into evidence are still owed — done in Phase 0.

F4_EDGE_HIGHLIGHT_RESPONSE_NOISE_FLOOR_E.evidence: no per-axis noise floor exists anywhere at HEAD; MATTE_VS_SATIN's current PASS record counts EDGE at 0.3604 against its measured 0.27991 seed-only floor. Held for Phase 2 per the brief.

F5_AXES_ARE_NOT_INDEPENDENT_AS_THE_LAW_R.evidence: axes_from at HEAD still reads highlight_fwhm_fraction on four regions; no correlation has ever been computed. Held for Phase 2.

F6_NO_STIMULUS_REALIZATION_CONTROL_EXIST.evidence: no realization gate exists in the instrument at HEAD; the only realization check lives in the external forensics script, which the instrument never runs.

F7_SILENT_ZERO_FALLBACKS.evidence: measure_texture_axes at HEAD: lag_mm stays 0.0 below the variance floor; contrast returns 0.0 on zero median. Both rejected axes reduce exposure but the return paths remain.

F8_ROUGHNESS_ONLY_READING_CORRECT.evidence: no code change since touched the roughness plumbing; the cleared hypothesis is carried forward so it is not raised a third time.

consequence_for_phase_1: every ruling number at HEAD (GRANULARITY admission 0.456, MATTE_VS_SATIN PASS axes, SATIN_VS_CREAM FAIL_MATERIAL_MODEL) was measured through the F2-contaminated 8-bit reader and is suspended pending Phase 1 re-measurement on scene-linear frames; none is carried forward.
